screens.screen: Health Flow circular home dashboard (Home Page client action)
screens.current_issue: Novelty circle-based navigation (health_flow_action.js) with a slide-in panel hides counts behind clicks; booking/CRM counts load into circles that carry no urgency, trend, or next action — it is a menu wearing a dashboard costume, and state persistence via localStorage papers over its lack of real content.
screens.redesign: Replace with an exception-first mission control: a calm 3-zone OWL shell (critical exceptions that grow with severity, a live day pulse strip, and a ranked next-best-action feed reusing the docked-actions NBA pattern). Circles become optional launcher chips; the screen leads with what is wrong and what to do, not where to go.

screens.current_issue: ops_booking_list_views.xml is a re-tagged flat list — dispatchers triage today's home visits from generic rows with no spatial context, no travel awareness, and no inline assignment; assigning means opening records one by one.
screens.redesign: Rebuild as a split dispatch workstation: unassigned-bookings tray on the left, linked map + web_timeline dual pane on the right, drag pin-to-nurse assignment through the existing validate_drop API, with SLA-proximity color pressure from theme tokens. One screen, zero record-opening for 90% of dispatch decisions.

screens.current_issue: roster_planning.js is a bespoke OWL grid with 12 hardcoded staff hex colors and its own service-type palette, disconnected from the theme token engine and duplicating the unified staff schedule (action 1536); it has no unassigned-work tray and no drag ghost/conflict preview.
screens.redesign: Consolidate onto the unified web_timeline schedule as a 'roster lens': token-driven colors, docked unassigned tray, ghost-preview drops with capacity-aware row highlighting, and alt-drag to stamp recurring series. One scheduling surface instead of two diverging ones.

screens.current_issue: staff_workload_dashboard_views.xml presents static per-staff counts with no capacity baseline, no travel burden, and no way to act on an imbalance from the screen itself — you can see overload but must go elsewhere to fix it.
screens.redesign: Turn it into a capacity heat matrix (staff x day) colored by booked-hours vs availability-matrix capacity including travel time, with drag-to-rebalance directly on cells and an AI 'suggest rebalance' action wired to the existing assignment engine.

screens.screen: CRM Center contact detail / lead workspace
screens.current_issue: crm_center_views.xml re-tags standard lead list/form/calendar views; the platform's unique assets — kinship relations (payer/caregiver/referrer), Zalo threads, VoIP call history, D3 relationship network — live on separate screens, so the 'contact-first' story dies in navigation.
screens.redesign: A relationship cockpit: single client canvas with the care-journey river (bookings, calls, Zalo, invoices on one time axis) as the spine, the D3 kinship network embedded as an actionable side panel (click payer node → send payment link), and docked NBAs ranked by lead stage.

screens.screen: Finance Center AR dashboard / Payments Due List
screens.current_issue: health_ar_dashboard_views.xml is a due-list styled listing (Healthcare Payments Due List) — aging is a column, not a picture; collectors cannot see who the actual payer-kin is or nudge them without leaving the row, and overdue clients sit in a separate fin.overdue.list view.
screens.redesign: A collections workbench: aging river visualization (invoices flowing through 0-30-60-90 bands), each row showing the payer relation from health.client.relation with a one-click ZNS payment-link action, package burn-down chips, and a 'day close' reconciliation rail replacing the wizard chain.

screens.current_issue: The 'today' route inside the monolithic 6,982-line app.js renders visits as a plain card list — no travel-gap awareness, no one-thumb action zone, small tap targets unsuited to gloves and sunlight, and sync status buried in an icon.
screens.redesign: A day-strip journey: visits as a vertical filmstrip with proportional travel gaps and live ETA, swipe verbs on cards (right = start travel, left = call), all primary actions in the bottom 40% reach zone, glove/sunlight token modes, and a sync-freshness edge tint. Split into proper components while at it.

screens.current_issue: The component explicitly marked 'END OF LEGACY ORDER-DETAIL-VIEW COMPONENT' in app.js is a long scrolling form mixing check-in, clinical notes, photos, quote verification and payment into one page — wrap-up steps get skipped and payment collection is buried below the fold.
screens.redesign: Replace with a staged visit flow: arrive (geofence auto check-in with confidence ring) → care (camera-first wound capture, big-digit vitals pad, voice memo) → wrap-up as a swipeable card stack (services confirm, signature, payment, next-visit confirm), each card offline-safe and completable in seconds.

screens.screen: Viet Uc landing dashboard (fullscreen Healthcare Dashboard)
screens.current_issue: landing_dashboard_views.xml launches a fullscreen client action that is a static tile hub (plus hub_spoke modal and FSO wizard buttons); every role sees the same tiles, so it adds a click layer without adding judgment — users learn to bypass it.
screens.redesign: Role-aware adaptive home built on the BFSI adaptive-shell pattern: coordinators land on dispatch exceptions, finance on collections risk, managers on capacity heat — each with a personal NBA feed and Cmd+K palette as the primary navigation, tiles demoted to a secondary launcher row.

screens.current_issue: health_fieldservice_order_views.xml is one long form where injection visits, consultations and wound care all show the same field walls; clinical protocol, equipment and pricing context are notebook tabs users must know to open, and the same fields appear regardless of state.
screens.redesign: VU-form-engine adaptive booking form: sections morph by service type and stage (only relevant clinical/equipment/consent blocks render), pricing-engine reasoning shown inline before confirm, docked NBA rail ranked by booking state, chatter at bottom full-width per platform standard.

screens.current_issue: assignment_scheduler_grid.xml exists alongside assignment_timeline_views.xml, assignment_web_timeline_views.xml and staff_schedule_views.xml — four overlapping assignment surfaces that fragment dispatcher habits and each implement partial conflict logic.
screens.redesign: Retire the grid and timeline duplicates into the single unified web_timeline schedule with pluggable lenses (grid density toggle, skills overlay, availability shading), all drops funneled through the one validate_drop API so conflict rules live in exactly one place.

screens.current_issue: Payment work is scattered across five modal wizards (payment_collection, nurse_payment, cash_delivery, payment_workflow, prepaid_package wizards) — collecting one visit's payment can traverse three modals, and context (client balance, package state) is invisible inside each dialog.
screens.redesign: One payment sheet: a slide-over panel on booking/invoice showing balance, package entitlements and history, with method tabs (cash/card/transfer/ZNS link) and a single confirm — wizards become internal server actions behind one coherent surface, matching the PWA's one-screen collection flow.

screens.current_issue: relationship_network_view.xml renders the D3 kinship graph as a standalone read-only destination — impressive on demo day, unused on work days, because nodes offer no actions and the graph is disconnected from booking/billing flows.
screens.redesign: Embed the graph as an interactive panel inside the client cockpit: nodes get action menus (call via VoIP, message via Zalo, send payment link to payer, book for dependent), edge thickness encodes interaction recency, and a time slider replays how the network formed.

screens.current_issue: lead_hub_views.xml duplicates CRM lead views inside the landing module, creating a second lead surface with its own filters; intake staff bounce between Lead Hub and CRM Center, and missed VoIP calls or Zalo enquiries never appear here at all.
screens.redesign: Merge into a single omni-channel intake queue inside CRM Center: one triage list fed by web forms, missed-call auto-leads (VoIP CDR) and AI-classified Zalo enquiries, each row carrying a one-click 'qualify → book' action that opens the booking wizard pre-filled.
